description: Small Ralph self-iteration for the current branch. There is no GitHub PR/check suite for this branch yet (`gh pr checks` reported no PR; `gh run list --branch ralph/self-iteration-20260519-034928 --limit 5` returned no runs). Local health probes before PRD creation passed: `npm --prefix web test -- --run` (267 files, 2795 tests), `npm --prefix web run build`, and `go test $(./scripts/ci/go-packages.sh)`. The previously named fresh-CI risks are covered in current main: `cmd/server/embed.go` embeds `cmd/server/web/dist` through the committed placeholder path, and US-453 streamless binary download tests are present and passing. The highest-value remaining OSv2 upper-layer gaps are skipped or weakened browser E2E gates around realtime recovery and action/version workflows.

userStories.name: Make SSE reconnect Playwright gate deterministic
userStories.description: Re-enable the Phase 7 SSE reconnect Playwright scenario by making the final row assertion deterministic when earlier specs have added more than one page of Northwind customers.
bdd_acceptance: Given Browser Live reconnects after an offline window and the customer table has more than one page of rows, When the scenario creates unique customers while the page is offline, Then the test searches or navigates by each inserted primary key before asserting that the rows are visible.
Given Playwright runs in list-only CI discovery, When `phase7/sse-reconnect.spec.ts` is parsed, Then the reconnect scenario is active and no longer hidden behind `test.fixme`.

Given Browser Live status is now exposed through the toolbar status element, When the reconnect scenario verifies restored transport state, Then it uses the current live-status surface instead of a stale realtime-indicator selector.

userStories.name: Restore optimistic concurrency browser gate
userStories.description: Fix the Northwind E2E seed/version precondition that keeps the optimistic-concurrency Playwright scenario skipped, so the browser gate can exercise stale-object recovery end to end.
bdd_acceptance: Given `scripts/e2e-setup.sh` seeds Northwind, When object history rows are inserted for seeded objects, Then each row carries the ontology scope required by the edits-history endpoint.
Given the seeded ALFKI customer has version history, When the Action Console loads `updateCustomerContact`, Then the object-version chip resolves instead of timing out.
Given Playwright runs in list-only CI discovery, When `phase6/optimistic-concurrency.spec.ts` is parsed, Then the stale-object scenario is active and no longer guarded by a permanent `test.skip`.

userStories.name: Make the US-444 action gate assert seeded actions
userStories.description: Strengthen the US-444 action Playwright probe so a full E2E stack with an empty Northwind action catalog fails loudly instead of skipping the action dispatcher contract.
bdd_acceptance: Given the full Northwind E2E seed has run, When `us444/04-action.spec.ts` lists action types, Then it expects a known seeded action such as `createCustomer` or `updateCustomerContact` instead of skipping on an empty list.

Given the action dispatcher receives deliberately invalid parameters for a known action, When the request is applied, Then the response is a structured 4xx ApiError envelope rather than a 5xx or empty body.
Given Playwright runs in list-only CI discovery, When the US-444 action spec is parsed, Then the action scenario remains discoverable without requiring a live backend.
